sovereign_country.strategic_role: 苏伊士运河经济特区、辐射中东及北非的低成本轻工制造

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Professional Multilingual Translation and Media Dubbing

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering and Funding of Terrorism, as amended by Law No. 36 of 2023; Regulations of the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMU); Decree No. 130 of 2023 concerning Beneficial Owner Statements; Companies Law No. 159 of 1981; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Legalized Certificate of Incorporation of the sole shareholder (if corporate member)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent foreign registrar or notary in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Egypt is a contracting state of the Hague Apostille Convention since 2021, in force since 13 April 2022)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the shareholder's passport or official ID
Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association (Egyptian official Arabic version)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and attestation by the Egyptian Notary Office

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and credit-professional proof for founding members

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMU) lists, United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions lists, OFAC SDN list, EU Annex lists, and domestically designated domestic terrorism and corruption lists. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for politically exposed persons (PEP), their family members and close associates; a written compliance risk assessment and customer risk profile must be prepared and retained for at least five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI (General Authority for Investment and Free Zones) Company Establishment and Name Reservation e-Service via www.gafi.gov.eg
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names may be registered in Arabic, English or French; however, a certified Arabic name (or Arabic phonetic transliteration) is mandatory for the official commercial registry record. The chosen name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered entity and must reflect the corporate identity and permissible activity under ISIC 7490 professional localization services. All non-Arabic script names must be accompanied by a certified Arabic transliteration approved by the GAFI language reviewers.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may file a formal administrative appeal to the GAFI Legal Affairs Department within 15 days of rejection notification. The appeal must include the desired name, justification of non-conflict, corroborating search results, and the company's intended business scope. If the administrative appeal is denied, the applicant may file a judicial reconsideration before the Egyptian Administrative Court within 60 days of the first rejection.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For a multilingual localization agency (ISIC 7490/NAICS 541930) classified as low AML risk, a virtual office is conditionally permissible in Egypt if contracted through a reputable registered service provider that offers a physical address for mail and service of process, and the company maintains at least one dedicated, evidence-proof substantive workspace or contingency business address. GAFI and the Commercial Registry may require physical premises if non-compliance is suspected.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low risk; estimated 12% chance of unannounced on-site inspection during the first operational year based on sectoral AML profiling.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: GAFI company name reservation and clearance fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and GAFI fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of Articles of Association and founding documents
Apostille/legalization of foreign incorporation documents and shareholder identification
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs Legalization Department and foreign competent authorities
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular and apostille statutory fees plus courier and agency benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial Registry initial filing and registration of LLC
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade / Commercial Registry Office
GAFI / Egypt Commercial Registry coordinated UBO repository

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication in the Egyptian Gazette (Al-Waqa'i' al-Misriyya)
External counsel pre-incorporation due diligence and compliance legal fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for cross-border LLC incorporation and AML/CFT screening

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended), Title on Limited Liability Companies (LLC), Articles 48-67; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 (where applicable); Executive Regulations of the Investment Law No. 231 of 2018
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) — Companies Registration Department and Commercial Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (نمط العقد النظامي), executed before a notary public and filed in Arabic with GAFI
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is imposed on LLCs under the current Egyptian framework; the authorized capital is freely determined in the Articles of Association. The entire issued capital must be fully subscribed at formation and the corresponding funds deposited in a temporary bank account opened in the name of the company under formation, remaining blocked until the Commercial Registry certificate is issued.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the preliminary share subscription list be and is hereby approved, confirming that the entire issued capital is fully subscribed by the members under the terms of the Articles of Association. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company be, and is hereby, fixed at [address, city, Cairo Governorate, Egypt], and the Managing Partner is directed to file the registered office address with the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones. RESOLVED, that the Members appoint [Name], [nationality], residing at [address], as Manager and legal representative of the Company, and [Name] as Assistant Manager, with full authority to execute all filings, open bank accounts, and procure all permits and licenses required for the commercial operation of the Company. RESOLVED, that the Manager be and is hereby authorized to issue and sign all necessary documents on behalf of the Company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Legal Form Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI — Commercial Registry and Name Reservation Department (online via GAFI Portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online application for the proposed company name (English and Arabic) and legal form LLC. The name must be unique, not contrary to public order, and end with 'LLC' or equivalent. Upon preliminary approval, obtain the name reservation certificate valid for a limited period.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name (Arabic primary, English transliteration)
Copies of founders' national ID / passports
Power of attorney if a founder is represented
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, the applicant may file an objection with the GAFI Name Reservation Committee within 15 days, submitting trademark registration evidence or a letter of consent from the existing name-holder.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and Authentication of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Notary Public (Shahr Al-Aqari) and Ministry of Justice Authentication Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in Arabic, have all founders or their authorized representatives sign physically before a notary, and then submit to the authentication office to obtain official notarization. The document must include the objective: 'professional multilingual translation, dubbing, localization and language services'.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association signed by all founders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary requests amendments, correct the wording and resubmit. In the event of authentication delay, escalate via the Ministry of Justice customer service or engage a licensed public notary intermediary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Deposit and Temporary Bank Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank licensed by the Central Bank of Egypt (authorized to open incorporation suspense accounts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary bank deposit account in the name of the under-formation LLC and deposit the subscribed capital. Obtain a capital deposit certificate evidencing full subscription. The bank will release the funds only upon presentation of the Commercial Registry certificate.
required_dossiers: Minimum paid-up capital deposit confirmation (no statutory minimum)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank declines the account due to anti-money-laundering checks, provide enhanced corporate ownership declaration and source-of-funds documents; if unresolved, apply to another licensed bank.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Filing and Commercial Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI — Companies Registration Department, Commercial Registry Office (submission via electronic file or in-person at regional GAFI branch)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation application with the authenticated Articles, capital deposit certificate, and directors' consents. Pay the statutory registration and publication fees. GAFI will review statutory compliance and issue the Companies Certificate and Commercial Registration certificate. The company acquires legal personality on issuance.
required_dossiers: Notarized and authenticated Articles of Association (original and copies)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI issues an inspection note requesting clarifications, respond within 10 business days with corrected documentation and pay any re-filing fee. Repeated rejections may be appealed to the GAFI Dispute Resolution Committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), National Social Insurance Authority, and Local Municipality Commercial License Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for Tax Card (بطاقة ضريبية) for corporate income tax, value-added tax (VAT), and payroll deductions. Register with the National Social Insurance Authority for employees. Obtain the municipal commercial license (İşletme Belgesi) for professional services from the local district office, using the commercial registration certificate.
required_dossiers: Lease agreement or registered office contract
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality or tax authority requires structural modifications, obtain a certified engineering report and resubmit; overdue tax registration may attract a late-registration fine, but a resolution with the ETA can be negotiated through its taxpayer services window.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — general commercial licensing only under the Municipal Administration and GAFI Commercial Registry; no industrial licensing board is triggered for a professional localization agency.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal Commercial Registration License for Professional Services (Ücretli Profesyonel Hizmet Ruhsatı) issued by the local district / neighborhood administration

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category 4 (non-industrial, no pollutant discharge); no environmental impact assessment or environmental permit is required for administrative office use.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero industrial discharges; office activities limited to computer equipment and low-voltage emission sources. Waste electrical/electronic equipment must be disposed in accordance with municipal solid waste regulations and EEAA compliance requirements for low-risk offices.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: General Civil Defense Directorate fire safety clearance is required for the leased office, including delivery of a fire safety certificate under Civil Defense Law No. 12 of 1983 and administrative regulations. The building must provide structural fitness certificate, fire extinguishers per area, clear evacuation paths, and a workplace health and safety certificate for employees.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) under the Ministry of Finance, official taxpayer portal https://www.eta.gov.eg; the Egyptian Customs Authority (ECA) is the competent customs authority, with the NAFEZA single-window foreign trade and customs clearance portal at https://www.nafeza.gov.eg; e-invoicing and e-receipts portals at https://einvoicing.eta.gov.eg and https://ereceipt.eta.gov.eg.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The foreign equity participants of an Egyptian limited liability company (EG_LLC) first complete incorporation through the General Authority for Investment and Foreign Trade (GAFI) one-stop shop, obtain the Commercial Registry extract, then file the unified tax registration application at the competent ETA district tax office. Required evidence pack: GAFI incorporation certificate, notarized articles of association translated into Arabic, Commercial Registry extract, board resolution authorizing registration, notarized power of attorney, original lease or purchase contract for the registered office, bank certificate of share capital deposit if applicable, passport copies and tax cards of managers and authorized signatories, and the digital e-signature certificates procured from the ETA accreditation authority. On approval, the ETA issues one unified Tax Identification Number (TIN) covering income tax, VAT, payroll tax and stamp duty, followed by the statutory Tax Card and a separate VAT registration certificate; new LLCs are simultaneously enrolled into the mandatory e-invoicing and e-receipts systems with a sandbox integration testing obligation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. The limited liability company is a juridical person under Egyptian Commercial Companies Law 159/1981 and is taxed separately under Income Tax Law 91/2005 at the 22.5% corporate rate on its worldwide profits with no pass-through to shareholders; no check-the-box or fiscal transparency election is available.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election exists under Egyptian domestic law. Available elections under Law 91/2005 as amended by Law 15/2023 and executive regulations include: (i) depreciation method election (straight-line versus declining balance) subject to ETA approval; (ii) small-business cash-basis election for turnover up to EGP 3,000,000; (iii) VAT input-credit pro-rata apportionment election for mixed taxable and exempt activities; (iv) Investment Law 72/2017 incentive elections, including accelerated depreciation, tax credit certificates and special zone regimes in the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE); and (v) foreign tax credit election instead of a deduction for foreign taxes paid under the applicable bilateral tax treaty, applied on an Egyptian-law-source basis.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016, Executive Regulations, and amendments introduced by Law No. 167 of 2022 and ETA implementing decisions.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 in annual taxable supplies of goods and services triggers mandatory VAT registration under Article 13 of Law 67/2016; voluntary registration is permitted below the threshold. Law 167 of 2022 additionally authorises the Minister of Finance to align a special small taxpayer presumptive regime within an EGP 500,000 to EGP 5,000,000 annual turnover band, under which businesses may be relieved from standard VAT compliance in exchange for a simplified lump-sum charge.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egypt mandates real-time electronic invoicing under ETA decisions 52/2020, 56/2020 and 139/2021 with phased implementation through 2023. Every VAT-registered entity, including a newly incorporated EG_LLC, must technically integrate its billing or ERP system with the ETA platform via the approved REST API (JSON and XML schemas), obtain an ETA integration certificate and SA/RA digital signing certificates, and transmit each B2B e-invoice for fiscal clearance before issuance. The ETA validates every document in real time and returns a Unique Identifier (UUID), an ETA validation code and a QR code in TLV protocol, which acts as the digital stamp replacing any physical rubber stamp or ink mark. B2C e-receipts are separately mandatory from 1 April 2022. Any invoice or receipt not cleared through the ETA platform is legally invalid, non-deductible for input VAT purposes and subject to a fine of EGP 10,000 to EGP 50,000 per violation under Article 62 of Law 67/2016, with prosecution where repeated.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating at 0% for exported goods and qualifying export services arises under Articles 8 and 12 of VAT Law 67/2016. For the multilingual localization agency (ISIC 7490), the following cumulative criteria must be satisfied: (i) the translation, dubbing, subtitling, transcreation or project-management service is contractually supplied to a non-resident client, and the legal, economic and practical benefit of the service is entirely outside Egypt; (ii) the service is truly performed from Egypt but not exploited, used or enjoyed by any Egyptian resident or within Egyptian territory; (iii) the consideration is paid in freely convertible foreign currency received through the Egyptian banking system, with Wise or Payoneer corporate balances subsequently settled into an Egyptian-licensed bank account and evidenced by a banking credit advice; (iv) a written international supply contract identifies the foreign counterparty and deliverables, supported by delivery records, client acceptance correspondence, source and localized file archives and foreign-currency conversion confirmations; and (v) the export sale is correctly declared in the monthly VAT return with full source documentation retained. For physical deliverables included in the commercial scope, legal exportation through Egyptian customs within the regulatory window is additionally required.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: NAFEZA e-Customs Export Declaration (Aqaba digitization platform) with ETA validation stamp and Egypt customs export code

Original Bill of Lading, Air Waybill or multimodal transport document evidencing physical departure of goods from Egyptian customs territory; for cross-border digital services, retained digital delivery and server-use logs demonstrating overseas consumption

Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) or banking credit advice issued by an Egyptian-licensed bank confirming receipt of export proceeds in convertible foreign currency within the Central Bank of Egypt repatriation window
Commercial invoice, perfected export services or goods contract, and non-resident certificate of the foreign buyer or client
ETA export evidence register and the monthly VAT return attachments substantiating the 0% declared export supply
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA applies enhanced scrutiny to exporters claiming zero-rating and input-VAT refunds, cross-matching the NAFEZA customs declarations, the e-invoicing system, the Central Bank of Egypt foreign-currency database, banking remittance records and the beneficiary ownership register. If export zero-rating is claimed fraudulently or with false or incomplete documentation, the ETA will retroactively assess standard-rate VAT of 14% on the full consideration, disallow all related input VAT credits, impose a monthly delay surcharge of 2% per month on the assessed VAT (capped at double the tax), apply fixed administrative fines of EGP 20,000 to EGP 50,000 per violating invoice, and claw back any VAT refunds already paid together with accrued interest under the five-year statutory limitation period. Deliberate evasion is referred to the Public Funds Prosecutor under Article 59 of Law 67/2016 and Article 133 of Income Tax Law 91/2005, exposing responsible legal representatives to imprisonment and criminal fines at least equal to the evaded tax, plus civil penalties of up to 300% of the assessed difference; export support rebate programmes and refund certificate privileges are simultaneously suspended or revoked.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) — the sole monetary authority and foreign exchange administrator, operating under Law No. 194 of 2020 and its implementing directives.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Egyptian pound (EGP) is convertible for current account transactions, including trade in goods and services, in accordance with Article 113 of Law 194/2020 and the CBE's registration requirements; capital account convertibility is restricted and requires prior CBE approval, particularly for derivative transactions and external borrowing. Profit remittance for foreign direct investment is permitted on the basis of audited financial statements, tax clearance certificates, and documentary evidence of the original injection of capital, but may face episodic administrative delays due to foreign currency availability and bank-level correspondent limits.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under CBE directives and the Unified Banking Law, all export proceeds for goods shipped from Egypt must be credited into an Egyptian licensed bank account within a maximum of six months from the date of issuance of the customs declaration or shipping bill; the mandatory surrender ratio is generally 0% for service exports, but goods exporters are required to repatriate 100% of proceeds into the Egyptian banking system, with the option to retain the foreign currency in an export proceeds account, subject to CBE approval for any conversion to EGP and for onward transfer to third parties.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium — (Wise_B2B, Payoneer). Offshore electronic money institutions (EMIs) are not licensed banks in Egypt and cannot provide local EGP clearing, but they can be used as ancillary cross-border receivables and disbursement channels for low-value localization services, provided all Egyptian source transactions are routed through a licensed bank and all proceeds in foreign currency are repatriated into the Egyptian banking system when the service is export-related; the CBE prohibits the use of EMIs for settlement of domestic Egyptian invoices or for circumvention of the banking channel.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance of at least one authorized signatory and the ultimate beneficial owner is mandatory for initial corporate account opening at Egyptian licensed banks; remote opening is not permitted for new LLC accounts. The bank requires original commercial registration certificate, tax card, power of attorney, shareholder registry, and verifiable local or regional operational address; foreign directors may attend via notarized power of attorney only after a physical in-country appearance of a local authorized representative.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) structure with foreign shareholders lacking Egyptian tax IDs
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Authenticated and apostilled UBO declaration, audited financial statements of shareholders, passport copies, proof of source of funds, and a CBE foreign investment registration certificate (for capital injection)

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected monthly transaction profile inconsistent with low-risk localization services
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business model description, signed contracts with overseas clients, invoice list, transfer pricing documentation, and projected cash flow statement supported by sector benchmarks

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border payments from high-risk jurisdictions or sanctioned regions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Trade contract with payment clause, sanitized SWIFT correspondence, end-client ownership chart, entity sanctions screening report, and legal opinion on dual-use media content compliance

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Receipt of US or EU rental fees without a clear commercial purpose
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Localization purchase orders, subtitling dubbing service agreements, milestone delivery certificates, and bank-preference letter on the nature of professional multilingual services

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign shareholder capital injections must be routed via SWIFT MT103 from an external account in the name of the foreign shareholder to a temporary Egyptian pound or foreign currency account at a licensed Egyptian bank, using purpose code CBE-Import/Service Payment or 'Capital Investment' under CBE Form 8 (Deposit of Capital), followed by submission of the CBE capital registration certificate to the General Authority for Investment (GAFI) and the Egyptian Tax Authority; verification is executed through the commercial invoice, share subscription undertaking, and the bank's Form 10 notification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements are cleared through SWIFT MT103 for high-value transferable debt obligations, with direct credit to the Egyptian correspondent account of the receiving bank; commercial letters of credit (L/C) are used for medium-duration localization service procurements involving subcontracted dubbing studios, narration studios, and voice artists in non-EGY countries, and disbursements are governed by UCP 600, requiring presentation of invoices, shipping/video delivery certificates, and customs or intangible service delivery acknowledgment.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forwards – deliverable forward contracts with a licensed Egyptian bank for a period not exceeding 360 days and only with an underlying trade or service transaction

FX Swap (Cross-Currency Swap) – permitted between EGP and a foreign currency provided that both legs have a confirmed underlying current-account or capital-account economic transaction and the tenors match the underlying settlement dates

Non-deliverable forward (NDF) – permitted for offshore risk management through a non-resident bank only if executed as an internal hedge or with the Egyptian bank acting as the pricing agent and the transaction being backed by an actual localization service receivable

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Unified Tax 52) for LLC income
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months of fiscal year-end; 30 April for calendar-year taxpayers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment penalty of 5% of tax per month or fraction until paid; assessments may be enforced administratively with lien and asset seizure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Annual Financial Statements and Shareholders' Approval Resolution
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI (General Authority for Investment and Free Zones), Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of the reporting year-end (30 June for 31 December balance date)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines per Companies Law 159/1981; persistent non-filing may expose the LLC to judicial strike-off and directors' disqualification

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of registration; for calendar-year book records, normally due by 31 January
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of EGP 100-500 plus 10% delay penalty for the listing fee; continued non-renewal leads to removal from the Commercial Register

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI Beneficial Ownership Registry and Egyptian Financial Action Task Force supervisor
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually with the audited financial statements and within 30 days of any ownership change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monetary fines under AML Law 80/2002 as amended; non-compliant managers may face criminal liability and the company may be subject to license suspension

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Tax Status Reconciliation and Final Settlement Declaration (where applicable under Law 91/2005)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same as annual corporate income tax return; included in the unified Tax 52 return package
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: As per CIT return: 5% monthly late penalty and up to double tax on concealment cases

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All Egyptian LLCs must appoint at least one licensed auditor and file audited accounts; no size or turnover exemption applies
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) based on IFRS; larger and export-oriented entities may adopt full IFRS where permitted

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC must keep a current beneficial ownership register, report any shareholding transfer or control change to GAFI within 30 days, and reconfirm the register annually with the audited financial statements; the register must identify every natural person ultimately holding or controlling 25% or more

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 22.5% (Income Tax Law No. 91/2005, Article 8, as in force for tax years beginning 2023).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone) projects under Law No. 83/2002 are exempt from income tax for the first 7 tax years; GAFI free-zone export companies may obtain 0% tax on export-derived profits; qualifying projects under Investment Law No. 72/2017 may receive a 50% profit-tax reduction for 7 years; export-support incentives may further reduce taxable profits on localization services supplied to foreign clients. Absent incentives, an EG_LLC localization agency is taxed at the full 22.5% headline rate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 44 (Corporate Income Tax Return), e-filed through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) unified electronic portal at portal.eta.gov.eg under the mandatory e-filing regime.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual corporate income tax return; quarterly advance-tax payments in the first three calendar quarters; monthly withholding declarations for salaries, rents and non-resident payments.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual Form No. 44 is due within four calendar months after the fiscal year-end (e.g., 31 December fiscal year-end -> due 30 April). Quarterly advance installments are due by the end of Q1, Q2 and Q3; any final balance is payable with the annual return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, Tax Card number, commercial register number, ETA file number, address, fiscal year-end, reporting currency, and the ISIC 7490 localization business scope.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Egyptian LLC is the taxpayer; non-resident shareholders are not named on the return. A resident legal representative with notarized power of attorney must be identified.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total billings from translation, subtitling, dubbing, localization QA, and media post-production services, net of returns, rebates and intercompany recharges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-revenue payments received via Wise or Payoneer must be translated into EGP at the Central Bank of Egypt exchange rate on the receipt date; segmentation by payor nationality is not permitted for Egyptian tax purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: SCZone 7-year income-tax holiday profit, free-zone export income, dividends received from Egyptian joint-stock companies, and Investment Law incentivized income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach GAFI/SCZone licenses; foreign treaty companies cannot claim these statutory exemptions through the Egyptian LLC unless the LLC itself holds the license.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 - Direct Costs / Cost of Sales
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Freelance translator and voice-talent fees, studio and equipment rental, cloud localization tooling, royalties on licensed master content, and production consumables.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduction of payments to non-resident freelancers and licensors requires documentary proof of 20% withholding tax or an approved treaty clearance for each invoice category.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 - Operating Expenses and Non-Deductible Add-Backs
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Payroll, marketing, insurance, IT, travel, depreciation; add back entertainment over-cap, penalties, hidden profit distributions, and non-characterized intra-group service charges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Related-party management fees are heavily audited; arm's-length pricing and benefit-test documentation must be annexed to avoid automatic add-back.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Offsets of tax losses originating from the five prior tax years, subject to Egyptian ownership-continuity rules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses cannot be transferred to or from the foreign parent; a change-of-control event may forfeit the carry-forward.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 - Tax Computation, Credits and Balance
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income at 22.5%, or at the applicable 11.25% or 0% concession rate; foreign tax credit; quarterly advance credits; final tax due or refund.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Treaty relief belongs in the withholding-tax line, not the profit-tax line; any foreign tax credit is capped by the Egyptian tax attributable to the foreign-source localization revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of the legal representative and ETA-licensed tax accountant, company seal, date, and annex list: TP disclosure, tax cards, WHT statements, GAFI exemptions, and board authorization.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident director may sign only through a certified local attorney-in-fact; all annexes must be uploaded digitally through the ETA portal.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fixed fine of EGP 100 to EGP 10,000 plus a monthly delay surcharge of 2% of the assessed tax for the first six months, rising to 2.5% per month thereafter, capped at 100% of the tax (Tax Procedures Law No. 206/2020, Articles 74-75). Late quarterly installments attract the same monthly surcharge; non-registration for a Tax Card is punishable with a fine of EGP 20,000 to EGP 50,000.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: ETA Quarterly Advance Tax Declaration (Quick Installment payment slip) settled through the ETA online payment gateway.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Quarterly (Q1, Q2, Q3 of the calendar/fiscal tax year).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due by the last day of each of the first three quarters of the fiscal year; for a 31 December year-end, by 31 March, 30 June and 30 September respectively.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 25% of the prior-year assessed tax, usable as a credit against the final annual Form No. 44 liability.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Newly formed LLCs without prior-year history pay based on the pre-estimate worksheet filed with the ETA at registration; a non-resident parent cannot fund the payment without recharacterization risk.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Bank and gateway transaction references evidencing payment of the installment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments must originate from the Egyptian LLC bank account; payments by foreign shareholders are treated as capital contributions, not tax payments, and will not be credited in Box 7.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-payment of an advance installment triggers the same delay surcharge as the annual return: 2% per month for the first six months, 2.5% per month thereafter, capped at 100% of the unpaid installment; interest at the central-bank rate may be added.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on profit distributions paid by an Egyptian LLC to non-resident shareholders under Income Tax Law No. 91/2005, Article 42; no additional branch-remittance tax applies.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA reduction: (i) obtain an original Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) for the relevant calendar year from the shareholder's home tax authority; (ii) submit an ETA treaty-relief application through the e-portal at least 15 days before the distribution, enclosing the TRC, the LLC board resolution declaring the dividend, shareholding registry proof, and a beneficial-ownership declaration; (iii) obtain the ETA reduced-rate clearance, then remit the dividend at the treaty rate. If clearance is pending, the full 10% must be withheld and a refund may be claimed within five years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties and technical service fees to non-residents: statutory WHT 20%, treaty-reduced typically to 10%-15% (e.g., Egypt-UK convention 12.5%). Interest on cross-border debt to non-residents: statutory WHT 20%; interest to foreign banks financing Egyptian projects may benefit from deemed-profit provisions effectively lowering the burden; DTA rates typically 10%-15%, subject to TRC, beneficial ownership and substance evidence.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File mandatory where aggregate controlled related-party transactions exceed EGP 10 million in the fiscal year; Master File mandatory where the global consolidated group revenue exceeds EGP 500 million; a TP disclosure annex must be filed with each annual Form No. 44 and the complete Local/Master File must be produced within 60 days of an ETA request (ETA Transfer Pricing Guidelines, aligned with OECD TPG).
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
